# Committed organizer data sample

**Organizer-provided synthetic data, subject to the organizer's data-use terms.** This directory is the only organizer data in the repository (CLAUDE.md rule 5). It is generated by `make data-sample`; do not edit it by hand. The full dataset lives under the gitignored `data/` directory and never enters git.

## Source

- The Factored AI & Data Hackathon 2026 organizer dataset (LATAM Bank, fully synthetic, generated for the event), read from the organizer S3 bucket (`data/` prefix) by `bank-data ingest --source s3`.
- Rows come from the contract-checked bronze layer (raw values as delivered, deduplicated like silver).
- The files keep the bucket layout (`<table>.csv` and `<table>/year=YYYY/month=MM/day=DD/<table>_YYYYMMDD.csv`), so `make pipeline` (source `sample`) builds bronze, silver, and gold from this directory alone, with no network and no credentials. `preview/` holds the first rows of each table for reading and is never ingested.

## Extraction

```bash
make data-sample    # runs: uv run bank-data sample (reads data/warehouse, the s3 source)
```

- Seed: `bank-data-sample-v1`. Customers are ranked by `sha256(seed || ':' || customer_id)` over the deduplicated bronze customers.
- The first 70 ranked customers are taken; after that, a customer is taken only when it covers a case the sample still lacks or adds complaints until there are 5, and the walk stops once every case is covered (74 customers were taken).
- Fact rows: the last 365 days of the dataset (process_date), capped per customer: transactions 30, call_center_interactions 5, satisfaction_surveys 5, complaints 5, campaign_sends 3, digital_events 8; call_transcripts follow the selected interactions. Within a cap, the first row of each rare type and status comes first, then rows in hash order.
- Referential closure: products of the selected customers; transcripts, surveys, and complaints only when the interaction or product they reference is selected; branches, service agents, marketing campaigns, and exchange-rate rows only when a selected row references them (rates: the USD rate of each business date whose transaction lacks amount_usd).
- Query outline (DuckDB over bronze Parquet): deduplicate each table with `row_number() over (partition by <primary key> order by <order column> desc, _etag desc, _source_key desc, _source_row desc)`, select the ranked customers' rows, apply the caps in Python, then pseudonymize.

## Column treatments

Direct identifiers are replaced by deterministic pseudonyms derived from the table, column, and row key with no secret, and never equal to any original value of the same column in the sample.

| Table | Column | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| customers | document_number | every digit and letter replaced in place (same length and pattern) |
| customers | first_name | invented name with the same number of parts |
| customers | last_name | invented name with the same number of parts |
| customers | date_of_birth | shifted by 1 to 365 days |
| customers | email | rebuilt from the pseudonymized names at example.com |
| customers | mobile_phone | country prefix and grouping kept, every other digit replaced |
| customers | landline_phone | country prefix and grouping kept, every other digit replaced |
| customers | address | invented street, number, and neighborhood |
| products | product_number | digits replaced in place (letter prefixes such as POL- kept) |
| service_agents | first_name | invented name with the same number of parts |
| service_agents | last_name | invented name with the same number of parts |
| service_agents | email | rebuilt from the pseudonymized names at example.com |
| service_agents | phone | country prefix and grouping kept, every other digit replaced |
| digital_events | ip_address | RFC 5737 documentation address (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24) |

Every other column is kept as delivered. Free text (transcripts, complaint descriptions and resolutions, survey comments) was profiled in phase 03: it is templated (for example `{monto} {moneda}`) and holds no names or identifiers. Branch contact details are the bank's, not a person's. The sample never contains credentials, `.env` values, or anything from the organizer data dictionary PDF.

This is organizer-provided synthetic data and remains subject to the organizer's data-use terms.
